'''I-Ming Chen''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 53 from Vista, Ca. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| August 1999 – January 2001

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115081500/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/alderaan.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). '''FL''' on those tables stands for Flight Leader, per [[Ming Huo]] and [[Scott Lingrell]].

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Chen playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>
